title: Repair read/acknowledge/snooze state persistence and company scoping
changes: Adds durable company-scoped Feed/Inbox presentation state backed by Titan business IndexedDB records.
Persists read/unread, presentation acknowledgement and snooze/unsnooze transitions across restarts.
Keeps presentation acknowledgement explicitly separate from Workforce notification lifecycle acknowledgement.
Requires explicit same-company proof before importing legacy global read IDs.
Exposes the state store through TITAN_FEED_PRESENTATION_STATE in the existing local storage bootstrap.
integration_note: Durable backend and message API are complete; protected titan-shell.js still uses legacy titanFeedRead until Manager/UI owner semantically rebases it.
